manifest.name: Net tools · SDK example
manifest.description: Calls any URL with sdk.net.fetch, reads the pipaya server API with sdk.serverApi, opens links and copies text.

descriptions.en: Calls any URL with sdk.net.fetch, reads the pipaya server API with sdk.serverApi, opens links and copies text.
descriptions.ko: sdk.net.fetch로 아무 주소나 호출하고, sdk.serverApi로 pipaya 서버 API를 읽고, 링크를 열고 텍스트를 복사하는 예제입니다.
